legalEntity: Great Research, LLC (Albuquerque, NM) and Ion Research, LLC (Alpharetta, GA), both listed as business addresses on the contact page; terms name Great Research, LLC and Research Holding, LLC and New Mexico law
coaAccess: Public lab-results library with lot-specific report images per product. The four sampled reports were read as PDFs on the Freedom Diagnostics Testing domain.
freeShippingThreshold: Free 2-day FedEx or UPS on domestic US orders over $250.
dispatchInfo: The shipping policy names UPS, FedEx and USPS, a same-day cutoff of 17:00 EST on business days and upgraded 2-day or next-day options at checkout. The FAQ gives shipping hours of 9:00 to 17:00 EST Monday to Friday and 13:00 to 15:00 EST on Saturdays and an estimate of 2 to 3 business days; the homepage advertises a cutoff of 18:00 EST on weekdays and 15:00 EST on Saturdays.

subscore_reasons.labVerification: All 4 sampled Freedom Diagnostics Testing reports were read on the laboratory domain, name Ion Research as client and carry the same lot codes as the shop's lab-results library; no retail vial was tested.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: The 4 opened reports measured 104.7% to 118.7% of the label amount, all above label; the Tesamorelin 30mg lot is the highest at 118.7%.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: The reports show HPLC purity, LC-MS identity and net content plus endotoxin, microbial PCR, elemental impurities and a fentanyl screen. A microbial PCR screen is not a sterility test.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: The contact page names two LLCs with street addresses and the terms name a third and New Mexico law; none of the entities was checked in a state business register for this audit.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: Carriers, a free-shipping threshold, tracking and a same-day cutoff are published, but the homepage gives a later cutoff than the shipping policy and FAQ; no delivery was tested.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: In 9 of 11 compound and size comparisons with at least three audited USD listings, the price per mg was below the median; regular and current prices were identical, so no sale prices apply.

strengths: All four sampled lab reports could be opened on the Freedom Diagnostics Testing domain, name Ion Research as client and match lot codes in the shop's public library.
The opened reports go beyond purity and content: endotoxin, microbial PCR, elemental impurities and a fentanyl screen are reported for each lot.
weaknesses: Several catalog items use code names (ION-3R, ION-2T, ION-1S, Tesa, Ipamo, §-31); the lab reports also list identities such as GLP RT and GLP TZ rather than compound names.
The homepage advertises a later same-day cutoff than the shipping policy and FAQ, and the legal pages name three different LLCs without a register check in this audit.
verdict: Ion Peptide publishes a lot-coded report library, and all four sampled Freedom Diagnostics Testing reports could be read on the laboratory domain with Ion Research as client. Measured content was 104.7% to 118.7% of label. The legal pages name three LLCs, and many products are sold under code names.
summary: US research-peptide shop at ionpeptide.com with a WooCommerce catalog, shipping to the United States and US territories and a public lab-results library. The contact page lists Great Research, LLC in Albuquerque and Ion Research, LLC in Alpharetta; the dispatch address is not published.
notes: Prices are the single-unit variation prices from the public WooCommerce Store API on 2026-11-24; regular and current price were identical for every sampled variation, so no sale price is recorded. Compounds were assigned only where the shop's own product text names them: ION-3R is described as LY-3437943 (retatrutide), ION-2T as LY3298176 (tirzepatide), Tesa as Tesamorelin, Ipamo as Ipamorelin and §-31 as SS-31. ION-1S is described only as a GLP-1 analogue and was left out, as were capsules, sprays, drops, blends, raw powders, supplies and products outside the compounds tracked here. The four reports are the shop's own lot submissions read as PDFs on the laboratory domain; the lab reports list identity results as GLP RT and GLP TZ for the two code-named lots. ionpeptides.com redirects to ionpeptide.com; ion-peptides.com returned a bot check and was not read. No account, cart or order was used.
